questions.question: Gold was discovered on the Witwatersrand in:
Witwatersrand gold was found mainly in:
options: Fine particles in hard conglomerate rock sloping deep underground

questions.question: Low-grade ore means:
options: Each tonne of rock contains only a small amount of gold
The gold is of poor colour

questions.question: The cyanide process, introduced in 1890, was important because it:
options: Recovered much more gold from crushed rock

questions.question: The Randlords were:
options: Leaders of the black miners' union
Very wealthy men who controlled the gold mines through mining houses

questions.question: Many Randlords first made their fortunes in:
Where did the mining houses raise most of their capital?
options: From investors in London, Paris and Berlin

questions.question: The firm of Hermann Eckstein, linked to Beit and Wernher, was known as:
The Chamber of Mines was formed in:
Why did mine owners care so much about costs?
options: The price of gold was fixed, so higher costs reduced profits

questions.question: WNLA, or Wenela, was set up to:
options: Recruit black workers across southern Africa

questions.question: Which complaint did the Chamber make against the Kruger government?
options: The dynamite concession made explosives expensive
The pass laws were too strict for owners

subtopics.title: Profits, Politics and the Error Museum

questions.question: A mine crushes 10 000 tonnes a month at 10 g per tonne. How much gold is produced?
At a profit of 50 pence a gram on 100 000 g, the monthly profit is:
Which statement belongs in the error museum?
options: The price of gold was fixed
The Chamber of Mines was a trade union for workers
The Rand needed companies and capital
Rand gold was in conglomerate rock

questions.question: The Jameson Raid of 1895 to 1896 was:
options: A failed armed invasion of the Transvaal backed by Rhodes

questions.question: Why could individual diggers not mine the Rand gold?
options: The rock had to be mined deep and crushed with expensive machines
There was no gold at all
The gold was in rivers far away

questions.question: Banket was the name diggers gave to:
Who was President of the South African Republic in 1886?

subtopics.title: The Rich Men of the Rand

questions.question: Which of these was a Randlord?
Where did many Randlords build grand houses in Johannesburg?
By the late 1890s, the Rand produced about:
options: More than a quarter of the world's gold
One percent of the world's gold

questions.question: Which country supplied a large share of the gold mines' black workforce?
What did the Chamber do to black wages in 1896?
options: Tied them to the gold price

questions.question: Uitlanders were:
options: Foreign, mostly British, immigrants in the Transvaal without the vote
